title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 + Mythos 5.2 (Nov 9) — one model, two safeguard tiers, ~30% faster
bullets.summary: Fable 5.2 (all users) and Mythos 5.2 (vetted security/life-sciences orgs, fewer cyber/bio blocks) are the same model at $8/$40 per 1M tokens, with an optional fast mode up to 2.5x quicker at $16/$80; output is up to 30% faster than 5.1 and it is available now incl. AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.
bullets.how: The Construct: re-benchmark default agent model + fast mode on latency-sensitive jobs (Hermes queue, scheduled runs) and re-check cost per run. PRAGMA: update client model-selection guidance. Brand 9 Signs: indirect (faster/cheaper logo-designer + ops agents).

bullets.title: Claude Meetings (beta) + Sheets/Whiteboards (beta); Claude Data and Interactive Connectors now GA
bullets.summary: Claude can join video calls as a visible participant, take notes, outline whiteboards and save action items to claude.ai; Claude Data (formerly Dashboards) and Interactive Connectors for Adobe, Atlassian, HubSpot, Salesforce, NetSuite and Workday are generally available, respecting user permissions with admin usage controls.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: Claude in client/Lennar calls to capture sign specs and action items straight into tasks. PRAGMA: Meetings + HubSpot/Salesforce connectors are a ready-made operator demo. The Construct: evaluate Claude Data vs the hand-built V4 dashboard panels.

bullets.title: Claude Code v2.1.319: denyInsteadOfPrompting, background MCP tasks, security fixes + loop/auto-mode behavior changes
bullets.summary: Per a DevelopersIO write-up (2026-11-08), v2.1.319 adds permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting, runs task-based MCP calls in the background, fixes a Bash permission bypass and a worktree sandbox escape; self-paced /loop now ends if a turn doesn't reschedule and Chrome shortcuts_* tools were removed.
bullets.how: The Construct: enable denyInsteadOfPrompting for unattended agents; audit loops/Chrome skills relying on removed behavior. PRAGMA: client hardening checklist. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Graphon Labs raises $35M Series A for persistent AI-agent memory
bullets.summary: Graphon Labs (SF, RRE-led, $43.3M total) sells enterprise, developer and on-device memory layers for agents, reporting 93.9% on LoCoMo (company-reported), with customers incl. HP, Hitachi and the 49ers.
bullets.how: The Construct: benchmark reference for our memory/PRAXIS inbox design — watch for an MCP/API before adopting. PRAGMA: 'agent memory' is a fundable category worth a client-briefing slot. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: When the platform ships a capability you hand-built (meetings capture, dashboards, connectors), re-run build-vs-adopt before the next sprint: keep only the custom layer that encodes your own judgment, and let the vendor carry the plumbing.
